2. It"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" reads the resulting IndexStore via `IndexStoreDB`'s `SymbolOccurrence` query API.

| `--configuration debug\|release` | Forwarded to the underlying build tool (d"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"efault: `debug`) |
| `--scheme <name>` | Xcode scheme to build (only for `xcodebuild`; auto-detected"},{"id":"p21s5","text":" if the project has exactly one scheme) |
| `--cache-dir <path>` | Directory for the incremental ind"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"ex cache (default: `<repo>/.scip-cache`). Passing this flag enables the persistent cache |

"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"| `--version` | Print the converter version and the Swift toolchain version it was built against |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Indexing multiple repos"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"`index-many` indexes two or more repos independently, writing one `.scip` per repo or merging
